folders.intro: Pick folders on the machine Wrench Board runs on. Files stay where they are. With Docker, the folder must be mounted into the container.

keys.fetched: Key fetched. Now save the settings.
keys.allegro_hint: Default: 1024 MiB. Large files need more memory. The import process as a whole can use additional memory.
keys.fz_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the stored key
keys.fz_hint: Source: cryptonek/illegal-numbers, alternatively yliu-d. The key only takes effect once you choose “Save settings”.

settings.saved: Saved. The library now uses the active collection.

audit.intro: Checks files with the real importers. Original files are not modified. A full run can take a long time on large collections.

formats.hint: Altium and EAGLE use KiCad. Allegro uses the bundled BoardRipper importer via Node.js.

settings.heading: Set up your workbench
